parsed.answer: I couldn't find a past ticket reporting this same problem: the keycap emoji 1️⃣ (digit + variation selector + combining enclosing keycap) rendering with the box misaligned against the digit. The retrieved tickets cover other glyph problems: a single-cell character (U+273D) drawn at the wrong size or placement, box-drawing characters that aren't antialiased, Nerd Font glyphs that are the wrong width, and Chinese characters duplicated while scrolling. None of them involve a multi-codepoint keycap sequence, so they aren't matches. Please leave this ticket open as a new report. Include the exact codepoints (1, U+FE0F, U+20E3), the font in use, and which graphics API is selected (Settings > Rendering). Also check whether the result changes when you switch the graphics API between Direct2D and Direct3D 11, or change the font. That information will help the team work out whether it is a grapheme-cluster width problem or a font fallback problem.
